VESSEL 369 II

S4 · Element 115

Grounded by design. It doesn't push through the air — it compresses space ahead and expands it behind, riding inside its own still bubble at zero G. Now with a self-generated wormhole departure, an EMP pulse, a green search beam and a blue drone split.
